data.rationale: The proposal captures the same procedure (Find a Park by State, then state, then park or section link) with state and section as parameters, but it merges park and section into one vague parameter, adds an unobserved "read or extract" step, and doesn't make the park-locating step explicit, so an automation would need guesswork.
